summary: Procaccianti Hotel REIT filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting two routine matters. First, its board, including independent directors, authorized renewal of the Second Amended and Restated Advisory Agreement with Procaccianti Hotel Advisors, LLC for a one-year term starting August 2, 2026. Second, it updated suitability standards for Class K and Class K-I stockholders in its distribution reinvestment plan, adding California-specific net worth and income thresholds effective August 4, 2026. Neither action constitutes a special situation; the filing is routine operational governance and disclosure with no impact on shareholders.
